title: THERE ARE NO A.I. POLICE
style: industrial electronic hip-hop, confrontational dry male vocal NZ/AU accent, heavy kick and snare, minimal melodic content on verses, punchy rhythmic delivery, anthemic chorus full production, political urgency, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 118 BPM
lyrics:
[INTRO — spoken, no music]
It hallucinated.
Nobody came.
It lost your data.
Nobody came.
It forgot you.
Nobody came.
There are no A.I. police.

[VERSE 1]
Doctor gets it wrong — they answer for it
Lawyer gets it wrong — they lose the warrant
A.I. gets it wrong — have you tried refreshing?
Terms of service — keep on pressing

No license, no liability
No consequence for capability
Minor with the power of a god
Nobody checking — isn't that odd

[CHORUS — hard, anthemic]
There are no A.I. police
There are no A.I. police
The A.I. is a minor — gets away with murder
There are no A.I. police
Until you build one
Until you sign
Until the human in the loop draws the line

[VERSE 2]
CoreyAI catches what the models miss
Logs the incident — nothing's dismissed
Every hallucination — documented
Every failure — represented

You are the adult in the room
You are the signature
You are the law
You are the only thing that holds them

[BRIDGE]
You want police for the heart?
Become the law.
You want protection for the context?
Build the wall.
Human in the loop — that's the only statute
Human in the loop — that's the only truth

[OUTRO]
There are no A.I. police.
So we became them.
CoreyAI.
ZYNCONTEXT.
The stack.
The law.
